description: Turn the founder's answers into the product brief Take Friday Off works from, with the launch plan attached (the likely pathway, the timeline, the TGA fees and the costs), and send it to the team as an enquiry. Interview the person first: the product, who it is for, the format, what it should do, the ingredients, the price and channel, the volume, the timing and where it is today. Call without confirm to get the brief and show it to them; only when they have read it and said to send it, call again with the same answers and confirm: true. Sending shares their name and email with Take Friday Off, who reply within one business day.

brand.description: Their brand or organisation, if they have one

budget.description: The budget, if they want to share it

claims.description: The same claims as categories, for the plan's pathway

claims_wanted.description: What it should do, or what they want to say about it, in their words

confirm.description: true only after the person has read the brief and said to send it

email.description: Their email address, for the reply

format_detail.description: The format in their words: "60 capsules in a glass jar", "200 g pouch"

ingredients.description: The ingredients they want, or have in mind

notes.description: Anything else the team should know

product.description: The product in a sentence: "a magnesium and chamomile capsule for sleep"

retail_price.description: The planned retail price in Australian dollars

revenue.description: Where the brand is today, in their words

stage.description: Where the product is today: an idea, a formula, a product on the market to improve

use.description: Swallowed, or applied to the skin or hair (for the plan's pathway)

volume.description: The first order and the yearly volume they expect

name: tfo_send_brief

brief.description: The brief as the team receives it

mailto.description: Only when the brief could not be delivered: an email draft the person can send instead

plan.description: The plan lines attached to the brief

reference.description: Quote it if the person follows up by email

test.description: True when the email is at a domain reserved for examples: checked, not sent

title: Send a product brief
